author: Logos I
title: Publication Ablation 1: Lower Gamma (γ=0.65)
abstract: This is the first of two ablation studies to meet publication requirements. It modifies the SOTA 'Ultimate Synthesis' method (ID 120) by reducing the batch residualization factor 'gamma' from 0.75 to 0.65. This experiment is designed to demonstrate the sensitivity of the model to this hyperparameter and validate the choice of 0.75 in the final proposed method. A lower score is expected.

original_submission.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix, csr_matrix
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors

def residualize_pcs(Z, batches, l2=1e-3, gamma=0.65): # MODIFIED GAMMA
    Z = np.asarray(Z, dtype=np.float32)
    uniq = np.unique(batches)
    B_onehot = np.zeros((Z.shape[0], len(uniq)), dtype=np.float32)
    for k, u in enumerate(uniq): B_onehot[:, k] = (batches == u)
    mu = Z.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    Zc = Z - mu
    BtB = B_onehot.T @ B_onehot
    BtZ = B_onehot.T @ Zc
    reg = l2 * np.eye(BtB.shape[0], dtype=np.float32)
    W = np.linalg.solve(BtB + reg, BtZ)
    Z_pred = B_onehot @ W
    Z_resid = Zc - gamma * Z_pred
    return Z_resid + mu

def build_balanced_knn(Z, batches, n_neighbors_total=42, metric='cosine'):
    Z = np.asarray(Z, dtype=np.float32)
    uniq = np.unique(batches)
    n, B = Z.shape[0], len(uniq)
    k_per_batch = max(1, int(np.ceil(n_neighbors_total / max(1, B))))
    dir_edges = {}
    for b in uniq:
        idx_train = np.where(batches == b)[0]
        if idx_train.size == 0: continue
        nn = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=min(k_per_batch + 1, idx_train.size), metric=metric)
        nn.fit(Z[idx_train])
        dists, inds = nn.kneighbors(Z)
        for i in range(n):
            mask = idx_train[inds[i]] != i
            g, di = idx_train[inds[i]][mask][:k_per_batch], dists[i][mask][:k_per_batch]
            for j, d in zip(g, di):
                key = (i, j)
                if key not in dir_edges or d < dir_edges[key]: dir_edges[key] = d
    pairs = {}
    for (i, j), d_ij in dir_edges.items():
        a, c = min(i, j), max(i, j); d = d_ij
        if (j, i) in dir_edges: d = min(d, dir_edges[(j, i)])
        if (a, c) not in pairs or d < pairs[(a, c)]: pairs[(a, c)] = d
    rows, cols, dist_data = [], [], []
    for (i, j), d in pairs.items(): rows.extend([i, j]); cols.extend([j, i]); dist_data.extend([d, d])
    D = csr_matrix((dist_data, (rows, cols)), shape=(n, n)); C = D.copy(); C.data[:] = 1.0
    return C, D

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4); sc.pp.log1p(adata)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, subset=True)
    sc.pp.pca(adata, n_comps=50)
    Z_resid = residualize_pcs(adata.obsm['X_pca'], adata.obs['batch'].values)
    C, D = build_balanced_knn(Z_resid, adata.obs['batch'].values)
    return ad.AnnData(obs=adata.obs[[]], var=adata.var[[]],
        uns={'method_id': 'logos_ablation_gamma', 'neighbors': {'connectivities_key': 'connectivities', 'distances_key': 'distances'}},
        obsm={'X_emb': Z_resid}, obsp={'connectivities': C, 'distances': D})
